newsitem.title: INDIA: ICICI BANK SHARE ISSUE SIX TIMES OVERSUBSCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: ICICI BANK SHARE ISSUE SIX TIMES OVERSUBSCRIBED.

text.p: India's second largest term lender, the Industrial Credit and Investment Corp of India, said on Wednesday the initial public offering of its subsidiary ICICI Bank, had been oversubscribed about six times.
"The offer has received overwhelming response from investors and ICICI has received over 600,000 application forms for about 240 million shares," ICICI said in a statement.
The issue, of over 41.25 million shares, at an offer price of 35 rupees, opened on August 5 and ran until Tuesday.
